briefings.title: LIVE: Howard Lutnick and Lilly CEO David Ricks expected to speak at Semafor summit
briefings.tldr: The U.S. is pivoting toward an aggressive "Build in America" industrial policy, targeting 6% GDP growth through massive domestic infrastructure investment and strategic equity stakes in tech companies, while simultaneously racing to lead the "Genesis Mission" of AI-driven scientific discovery and the commercialization of space and fusion energy.

briefings.title: NVIDIA & Eli Lilly: The AI Revolution in Drug Discovery | Jensen Huang & David Ricks
briefings.tldr: NVIDIA and Eli Lilly are partnering to revolutionize drug discovery by building the world's largest dedicated on-prem biology supercomputer and a co-innovation lab, applying advanced AI to simulate human biology and accelerate the development of new medicines.
